```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
breeding_site_locations <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
glimpse(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
df_mika <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(df_mika))
```

```{r}
glimpse(df_mika)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- breeding_site_locations |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
migration_site_locations <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

migration_site_selected <- migration_site_locations |>
  select( 
    Site,
    winterLongitude,
    winterLatitude,
    pslon,
    pslat,
    iblon,
    iblat,
    awestlon,
    awestlat
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat
  )
gt(head(migration_site_selected))

```


```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- breeding_site_locations |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <- migration_site_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
